description: Defines the TaskPool class which manages tasks, handles events, and processes CMDU messages within the beerocks namespace. It includes methods for adding tasks, sending events, running tasks, and handling network messages.

classes.name: TaskPool
classes.description: A singleton container managing tasks, events, and message handling in the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: add_task
methods.description: Adds a new task to the task pool.

methods.name: try_send_event
methods.description: Attempts to send an event to a registered task.

methods.name: run_tasks
methods.description: Executes all tasks in the pool within a specified duration.

methods.name: send_event
methods.description: Sends an event to a specific task or globally.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes an incoming CMDU message and dispatches it to tasks.
